title: CAD/CAM AGI Orchestration System — Foundation
brief: Build the intelligent CAD/CAM AGI orchestration system with adaptive LOC-based parameter adjustment, auto-selection chains (stock/fixture/tool), and master post-processing for optimal G-code generation.

units.title: LOCBasedAdaptiveParameterEngine — Core
steps: Implement instantaneous LOC calculation from toolpath geometry
Implement RPM adjustment formula based on LOC (engagement factor)
Implement feed rate adjustment with chip thinning compensation
Implement stepover adjustment for constant MRR
Wire to VariabilitySourceTrackerEngine for drift detection
Add 25+ unit tests covering LOC ranges 0.1D to 1.0D
units.description: LOCBasedAdaptiveParameterEngine — Core — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: AdaptiveEngagementMonitorEngine — Real-time Tool Engagement
